subject: Tenant bootstrap & network acceptance compact
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex@caregrid.io>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Tenant bootstrap & network acceptance compact

Diego / Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. CareGrid is excited to start the evaluation; our internal stakeholders want a short, concrete checklist we can follow to get a test tenant provisioned and the network handshakes done. High level asks from our side:

- Org + tenant creation (we need a stable org id to wire SSO and service accounts)
- API key generation for non-prod evaluation (ephemeral vs long-lived guidance)
- IP allowlist ranges to configure on our firewall
- VPC peering window (we use AWS us-west-2) and expected downtime/flow

Do you have a suggested 2-week MAP that covers these items and close criteria (we want to run a short end-to-end gen/latency test and a small model cost run)?

I can loop in our infra lead, Sarah Lim (cc'd). Ideally we'd have the tenant + keys ready by next week so we can start smoke tests.

Attachments: none from us yet — happy to take whatever template you use for peering.

Best,
Alex Chen
Sr. Product Manager
CareGrid Health
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex@caregrid.io>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 May 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Tenant bootstrap & network acceptance compact

Alex — thanks, and great meeting. I've put together a short technical runbook and proposed MAP attached (redwood_map_timeline_v1.xlsx). Summary below with owners and acceptance criteria so we can sync quickly:

1) Org & Tenant creation (owner: Diego)
   - What we need from CareGrid: preferred org name, SSO domain (if you want SSO), billing contact.
   - Redwood will provision a test tenant id and post the tenant id + admin user within 24 business hours once we have the SSO info.
   - Acceptance: admin can issue API keys and hit the /health endpoint.

2) API keys & service accounts (owner: Diego)
   - We recommend creating a non-prod API key scoped to evaluation models + separate ephemeral keys for CI if you plan automated tests.
   - Steps included in the attachment with CLI snippets. If you need a long-lived key for SRE, we'll generate and flag it but note the recommended rotation cadence.

3) IP allowlist (owner: CareGrid / network)
   - From Redwood: outbound egress will come from the following CIDRs: 34.82.16.0/24, 35.199.32.0/24 (these are example ranges; final ranges will be confirmed before peering).
   - Please share the specific public IPs your firewall will use for the tests; we'll add them to the tenant allowlist.

4) VPC peering (owner: Jonas)
   - Jonas Weber will be the technical lead on the peering. He'll start with our peering template (network_peering_template.pdf attached) and propose three 2-hour windows.
   - Expect 15–30 minute verification for route propagation; no planned downtime.

Close criteria: successful token-auth'ed generation (latency < 200ms p50 for a 128-token request), embedding roundtrip baseline, and a brief cost/burn report for the test workload. Proposed MAP timeline in the spreadsheet: provision (Day 1–2) → keys & allowlist (Day 3–4) → peering (Day 5) → smoke tests (Day 6–7).

Next steps: 1) Alex/Sarah to confirm org name + firewall IPs; 2) Naomi will follow up on SOC2 evidence and KMS questions; 3) Jonas will propose peering windows.

Diego
Diego Fernandez
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_map_timeline_v1.xlsx
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex@caregrid.io>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 May 2025 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Tenant bootstrap & network acceptance compact

Alex — quick security checklist to help streamline approvals on your side:

- SOC 2 scope: Redwood will provide SOC 2 Type II summary and the auditor contact if you need direct confirmation.
- Data residency: evaluation tenant will process data in us-west-2 (we can provision eu instances later).
- KMS options: we can use Redwood-managed encryption keys or integrate your KMS (we support AWS KMS customer-managed keys). Let us know preference for non-prod.
- Audit logs: we can enable request-level audit logging for the tenant; this will increase log volume retention costs (if you want 90d vs 30d let us know).

I'll also add a short checklist for the security reviewers into the spreadsheet and flag the items that need completed before peering. Jonas — can you propose two peering windows for next week?

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
From: Alex Chen <alex@caregrid.io>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@caregrid.io>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 May 2025 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Tenant bootstrap & network acceptance compact

Diego / Naomi — thanks for the clear plan. Per our infra team (Sarah):

- Org name: CareGrid-Eval
- Firewall public IPs for test node: 52.24.11.42, 52.24.11.43
- We will accept the Redwood CIDR list for initial tests; please confirm final ranges before peering.
- KMS: we'll use Redwood-managed keys for the eval (we'll revisit customer-managed for prod).

Sarah is available next Monday (6/2) morning for the peering window; otherwise Tuesday afternoon works. We can sign the mutual action compact — send me the DocuSign link and we'll route it.

Regards,
Alex Chen
Sr. Product Manager, CareGrid Health
Attachments: none
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex@caregrid.io>, Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@caregrid.io>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Jun 2025 16:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Tenant bootstrap & network acceptance compact — confirmed timeline

Alex / Sarah — great, thanks for confirming. Finalizing the action items and timeline here so everyone has a single source of truth.

Action items (owners & ETA):
- Diego: provision tenant "CareGrid-Eval" and create admin user (ETA: Tue 6/3 12:00 PDT).
- Diego: create evaluation API key and post CLI snippets in the spreadsheet (ETA: Tue 6/3 15:00 PDT).
- CareGrid (Sarah): confirm firewall NAT for egress and confirm if the 52.24.11.42/43 addresses are static (ETA: Tue 6/3 EOD).
- Jonas: open peering request and propose 2x windows (Mon 6/9 09:00–11:00 or Tue 6/10 13:00–15:00 PDT). He will execute the peering once routes are approved.
- Naomi: SOC2 summary + audit contact posted to the shared Drive link (ETA: Wed 6/4).

Acceptance criteria (same as earlier): tenant admin can issue keys, peering established and verified, smoke tests pass (latency + basic cost report).

DocuSign: sending the mutual compact now (https://docusign.example/sign/abc123). Please sign when you have a moment so we can move the tenant from "provision pending" to "active."

Looking forward to the tests — I'll post the tenant id and keys into the spreadsheet once done.

Diego Fernandez
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
Attachments: network_peering_template.pdf
